events.title: PrestaShop released
events.summary: Bruno Lévêque and Igor Schlumberger launched the PrestaShop platform in August 2007 — a free PHP e-commerce project that reached version 1.0 in July 2008.
events.about: PrestaShop offers catalog, cart, checkout, and back-office tools for merchants who want self-hosted commerce without Magento's complexity. Popular in Europe and Latin America, it competes with WooCommerce and OpenCart on shared hosting and VPS deployments.

narrative.whyChosen: PrestaShop brought accessible open-source e-commerce to European SMB merchants.
narrative.whyImportant: It expanded the PHP commerce ecosystem beyond osCommerce and early Magento.
narrative.problemSolved: Small retailers needed affordable store software without enterprise licensing fees.
